source.author: verg
source.text: mella fluant illi, ferat et rubus asper amomum.
source.text_original: mella fluant illi, ferat et rubus asper amomum.
source.text_english: May honey flow for him, and may the rough bramble bear perfume.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Terram autem lacte et melle manantem, hyperbolice debemus accipere pro rerum omnium abundantia, ut est illud: Mella fluant illis, ferat et rubus asper amomum.
reuse.text_original: Terram autem lacte et melle manantem, hyperbolice debemus accipere pro rerum omnium abundantia, ut est illud: Mella fluant illis, ferat et rubus asper amomum.
reuse.text_english: But we ought to understand the land flowing with milk and honey hyperbolically, as meaning an abundance of all things, as in the saying: Let honey flow for them, and may the rough bramble bear amomum as well.
